title: Grant #16 HOOK-B (hook-3..hook-4) - map agent hook, round 3
note: STYLE_LOCK 1a + 1c + 2b: clean first frame, nothing before it is spoken, one big card at a time, ONE continuous zoom, visible fire only
frames: frame 0 = hook-a's last frame (16 Feb, the pocket blue)
rewind: white flag drops, the pocket red again, units step back
'the fifteenth of February': the date rolls back
'At dawn': dawn light, push in, colours dissolve into the fronts
'burst out': red columns break out, volleys where lines touch
'broken the Union right': BROKEN, the brigades fall back
'the road out stood open': the Forge road glows, THE ROAD OUT
'The Union commander': the '?' badge, the HQ
'not even there': the empty HQ, NOT EVEN THERE
'away on a gunboat': the flagship, the '?' rides on it
'when he rode back': the '?' rides back, dotted trail
'standing in knots, holding muskets': knots of blue men
'tons of it, close at hand': crates glow, TONS OF IT
the map dims, the '?' comes to the centre
'a few weeks earlier his own superior...' (unnamed: no photo)
'brushed off his plan': HIS PLAN + BRUSHED OFF
CUT 1 'He took two rivers': henry map, both forts blue, 1 TWO RIVERS
CUT 2 'the city that held...': Vicksburg at night, boats run the batteries
CUT 3 'marched a whole army across a river': the pontoon bridge
'Robert E. Lee': pull back, Lee's badge + his army
'looking the other way': his army faces north, away
